toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Ruu character design and the only visual reference. Preserve Ruu exactly: 19-year-old petite adult scout, near-black deep-purple tousled short hair, golden cat eyes, guarded mischievous expression, dark charcoal lightweight scout outfit with purple accents, fingerless gloves, boots, belt pouches and short knife in a sheath at the waist, colors and bold simple anime-manga cel style.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Ruu, equally spaced left to right, identical scale, same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing RIGHT; nose, chest and toes point right, back of head left. No three-quarter.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: arms slightly away from torso and naturally lowered, hands relaxed, feet parallel, no dramatic action pose or exaggerated T-pose. Keep face and neck uncovered, no hood. Rotate the waist sheath and pouches consistently on their physical sides; knife remains sheathed and is not drawn in hand. Back view is a restrained logical continuation, with no invented loot or extra weapons. Full hair and feet visible, identical scale and baseline, generous spacing.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no dramatic light, no large ground shadows. Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below the figures. No other text, no name, no watermark.
Avoid: any 3/4 angle, mirrored side direction, extra figures, child/chibi proportions, hood, held weapon, stolen goods, new decorations, cropped head or feet.
